decisions.reason: S-D7 makes the volume control a scroll wheel.
S-D9 says the scroll wheel will be small.
S-D9 says the scroll wheel will be yellow.
The Interface Layout notes say yellow matches the Real Reaction colours.
No part mentions a recharging stand or dock.
The notes say the case is hard plastic but nothing gives the button material.
S-D1 and the Materials notes state a hard plastic case, not rubber.
No part says the remote has no LCD screen.
S-D4 gives a 2D curved shape and S-D8 mostly square with rounded corners.
No part mentions changeable faces or five of anything.
S-D10 and S-D11 include speech recognition.
Settled: S-D10 and the tldr say an advanced chip, S-D3 and the notes say the regular chip, so a reader cannot tell which.
